All analyses were performed using **R 4.3.2** within an Rstudio Docker container ([bakeronit/rstudio_hpc_cancer:0.1.3](https://hub.docker.com/layers/bakeronit/rstudio_hpc_cancer/0.1.3/images/sha256-e288941e0ab0b4a5e2152225169853912342132fbae370241e1d26912b270d5a)).
